diagram_title: PatentDrafter Repository Inventory — C4 Component Diagram

systems.name: PatentDrafter Repository
systems.description: Prompt-first patent drafting repository containing orchestration assets, design docs, and sample outputs.

containers.name: Prompt Asset Layer
containers.description: Main orchestration prompts and patent writing knowledge sources.

containers.name: Agent Contract Layer
containers.description: Subagent prompt contracts for each patent drafting stage.

containers.name: Documentation Layer
containers.description: Long-lived architecture, IDEF0, Grafcet, and product specification docs.

containers.name: Sample Artifact Layer
containers.description: Sample pipeline inputs and outputs used as execution evidence.

containers.name: Utility Layer
containers.description: Helper scripts and modeling experiment assets.

components.name: Main Workflow Prompt
components.description: Defines the top-level eight-stage orchestration contract.

components.name: Patent Writing Knowledge
components.description: Defines domain-specific patent drafting rules and legal writing constraints.

components.name: Stage Agent Definitions
components.description: Defines stage-specific agent prompts and expected outputs.

components.name: Architecture Design Docs
components.description: Describe intended system decomposition and workflow design.

components.name: Product Spec Docs
components.description: Describe target product capabilities and operating expectations.

components.name: Sample Pipeline Outputs
components.description: Provide observable evidence for the file-based drafting workflow.

components.name: Helper Scripts
components.description: Support validation and text processing tasks.

components.name: Modeling Experiments
components.description: Contain HLS and Grafcet experiment files outside the main prompt pipeline.

components.name: Specs Architecture SSOT
components.description: Normalized architecture truth for future planner and builder sessions.

components.name: Planner Contract Package
components.description: Execution-ready planning package for follow-up implementation work.
